name: SAMPLE machine: sampler for samples on the +Drive, one shot or loop, forward or reverse (Cycles One-Shot 0.11)
description: Plays a sample from the +Drive once per trig, or in a loop (RETRIG + PUNCH), forward or reverse (RETRIG + GATE): 6-tap polyphase at 96 kHz, the stock decimator, the amp chain set up like TONE, then the Model:Samples' filter. A loop goes round what Start and Length select with a hard seam, as on the Model:Samples, so a single cycle loops without a step; a trig that cuts a sounding note brings the new one in over 0.67 ms. The sample is chosen in the PRESET browser and saved with the sound, the switches too; the main screen shows the pattern's number, the track's number and level, the sample's name with L and R while the switches are on, and its waveform.

uses.why: Loop, a switch: bit 8 of k 32, which the voice reads in the note's sound every block; the shortcut layer flips and saves it
Reverse, a switch: bit 9 of k 32, which the voice reads in the note's sound at the trig; the shortcut layer flips and saves it
the browser reads the opened file: a sample file on a SAMPLE track names the sample instead
sound to record, version 2: the sample's key into record slots 24..27
record to sound: the key back
the screen's redraw, about 30 Hz: loads and frees samples
MainScreenView's draw method: the waveform on a SAMPLE track

formatters.why: an interface object has one formatter, and object 53 is also SNARE's SWEEP: smp_fmt_cutoff falls back to the stock one off SAMPLE's tracks and is put in only while the stock one is there (machine/view.c)

emulation.status: not measured with mcengine.py; One-Shot's README states about 800 instructions per track and block for the filter alone

changes: the filter runs inside the machine, before Volume + Dist; the Model:Samples has it after
on its tracks, RETRIG held + PUNCH or GATE flips Loop or Reverse instead of PUNCH or GATE, and their LEDs show those switches while RETRIG is held
unchanged: at Cutoff 0 the track is untouched bit for bit
presets on other machines load as before
TRACK + PUNCH or GATE (Control All), with or without RETRIG

conflicts_declared.why: plays sample files from the same browser and needs Model-TG
